description: Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences (RBINS): rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences (RBINS). Coverage: Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences (RBINS). The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Stations de surveillance du site de dépôt de munitions de Paardenmarkt; PMPZ : PCB dans le biote par Station de Phytopharmacie; WATERHYPERNET : Ensemble de données de mesures de radiométrie optique . Formats seen: HTML, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial–NoDerivs 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
